content.text: Now add the `OwnerIdentity` schema before `Owner:`.

input.old_string:
Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
input.new_string:
OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's version-2 identity block, grouping the derived identifiers.
        The region code mixed into these identifiers carries the fixed 'V2'
        version tag, so every value differs from the version-1 identity. The tag
        appears only inside these identifiers, never in the user-facing
        'locality', 'timezone' or the owner segment's derived region.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The version-2 member identifier formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>',
            where REGION is the version-2 region code (the canonical region with
            the fixed 'V2' version tag mixed in), FY is the 2-digit fiscal year,
            HASH8 is 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of
            '<normalizedTelephone><lastName>', and CHK is a single Luhn check
            digit over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Collision handling
            appends '-<n>' with the smallest n of 2 or more that makes it unique.
          type: string
          example: 'V2NSW271A2B3C4D5'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            The version-2 deterministic household identifier: the first 12 hex
            characters of the SHA-256 digest of the household key
            '<normalizedLastName>|<postcode>' with the fixed 'V2' version tag
            mixed in. Owners with the same last name and postcode share the same
            value automatically.
          type: string
          example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            The version-2 derived identity key: the lower-case hex SHA-256 digest
            of '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>' with the
            fixed 'V2' version tag mixed in. All duplicate detection is expressed
            through this single key: a create is rejected with 409 only when a new

OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's version-2 identity block, grouping the derived identifiers.
        The region code mixed into these identifiers carries the fixed 'V2'
        version tag, so every value differs from the version-1 identity. The tag
        appears only inside these identifiers, never in the user-facing
        'locality', 'timezone' or the owner segment's derived region.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The version-2 member identifier formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>',
            where REGION is the version-2 region code (the canonical region with
            the fixed 'V2' version tag mixed in), FY is the 2-digit fiscal year,
            HASH8 is 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of
            '<normalizedTelephone><lastName>', and CHK is a single Luhn check
            digit over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Collision handling
            appends '-<n>' with the smallest n of 2 or more that makes it unique.
          type: string
          example: 'V2NSW271A2B3C4D5'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            The version-2 deterministic household identifier: the first 12 hex
            characters of the SHA-256 digest of the household key
            '<normalizedLastName>|<postcode>' with the fixed 'V2' version tag
            mixed in. Owners with the same last name and postcode share the same
            value automatically.
          type: string
          example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            The version-2 derived identity key: the lower-case hex SHA-256 digest
            of '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>' with the
            fixed 'V2' version tag mixed in. All duplicate detection is expressed
            through this single key: a create is rejected with 409 only when a new
            owner's whole identity key exactly matches an existing owner's.
          type: string
          example: '3b7f0c2e1a9d4f5e6b8c0a1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c'
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - memberId
        - householdId
        - identityKey
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR).
            When present it is combined with the last name to form the
            'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility (the flat address form). On output it is the composed,
            normalized address: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space
            and the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' input when present (non-blank). Normalized on
            create (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common street-type
            abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Normalized on create like addressLine1 and, when present, appended to
            the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            afterwards; the stored and returned value is that 10-digit string.
          type: string

All 70 tests pass with **BUILD SUCCESS**.

## Summary

I released version 2 of the owner identity. Every identifier is now rederived with a fixed `V2` version tag mixed in, so no version-1 value can recur — while the user-facing `locality`, `timezone` and owner-segment region stay the plain region code.

**Identity derivation (V2 tag mixed in):**
- `Owner.getIdentityKey()` — now `SHA-256("V2|<telephone>|<email>|<soundex>")`, still a 64-hex digest (`Owner.java`, added `IDENTITY_VERSION_TAG = "V2"`).
- `generateHouseholdId()` — now hashes `"V2|<lastName>|<postcode>"`; owners with the same last name + postcode still share it.
- `generateMemberId()` — the region *inside* the id now comes from `deriveRegionV2()` (`"V2" + canonicalRegion`, e.g. `V2NSW271A2B3C4D5`).

**Region stays plain outside identifiers:** `OwnerMapper.deriveLocality()` no longer parses the region out of the member id (which now carries the `V2` tag). It derives the canonical region directly from postcode range → city table → `UNKNOWN`, so `locality`/`timezone`/`ownerSegment` remain plain (`NSW`, `Australia/Sydney`, `STANDARD_METRO`).

**Response shape:** `memberId`, `identityKey`, `householdId` are grouped under a new nested `identity` object and removed from the top level; a top-level integer `apiVersion: 2` was added. Implemented via a new `OwnerIdentity` schema in `openapi.yml` (generating `OwnerIdentityDto`) plus `deriveIdentity(owner)` and `API_VERSION` mappings in `OwnerMapper`.

**Audit schema v2:** the structured `OWNER_CREATED` event now leads with `"schemaVersion":2` and carries the version-2 member id.

Request fields are unchanged. The full suite (70 tests, including the updated Cp28/32/36/41/46/52/53/55/56/57/60 and all pre-existing behaviours) is green.
